versions.changelog:
Initial release: Automates creation of a full freelance client onboarding package from a single project description.

- Generates project brief, custom tech stack, milestone plan, and proposed folder structure.
- Includes CLAUDE.md and a ready-to-send kickoff message.
- Tailors assumptions for timeline, budget, and stack when details aren’t provided.
- Runs when onboarding a new freelance client for streamlined, professional setup.
